values.name: Stop only for boarding
values.description: Stop only for boarding Travel service stops at a given location, only to pick up travellers.

values.name: Stop only for alighting
values.description: Stop only for alighting Travel service stops at a given location, only to allow disembarkation.

values.name: Technical stop, without boarding or alighting
values.description: Technical stop, without boarding or alighting Location where a travel service makes a technical stop without allowing passengers to board or to disembark.

values.name: Passing location
values.description: Passing location Location where a travel service passes without stopping.
